From the owner
One of the most common calls we get at AZ BathMasters comes from Phoenix homeowners with a tub they never use and a bathroom that feels cramped and outdated. A tub-to-shower conversion is often the answer, but there are a few things worth understanding before you commit. 🔧 First, Phoenix homes are primarily built on slab-on-grade foundations. Moving a drain in a concrete slab takes the right tools, the right permits, and a contractor who knows what they're doing. We've handled this exact situation many times across the Valley. Second, the conversion gives you back usable square footage. A walk-in shower with a frameless glass door, custom tile, or an acrylic surround will not only feel more spacious but will also add real value to your home. Third, materials matter in Arizona. Our hard water is tough on standard grout and low-quality acrylic. We help homeowners choose surfaces that hold up to desert conditions and stay looking great long-term. 📍 We serve Phoenix, Scottsdale, Glendale, Peoria, and Surprise, and we offer free in-home consultations so you can get real answers before you make any decisions. No pressure, no sales pitch. Just honest guidance from a locally owned team.

Discolored, porous grout lines can quickly make even the cleanest tile floor look aged and neglected. Investing in professional grout sealing in Fresno County creates an invisible, protective barrier that stops spills, dirt, and moisture from sinking deep into your tile work. Applying a high-grade sealer today makes everyday sweeping and mopping effortless while guarding your shower walls and kitchen floors against stubborn mold and deep staining. Beyond preserving your surface finish, sealing your grout prevents water from seeping underneath, protecting subfloors from costly moisture damage across the Central Valley. At Baker Tile, we bring true craftsmanship, top-tier protective sealants, and years of hands-on local experience to every residential and commercial space. Our skilled crew takes immense pride in thorough surface preparation, ensuring your lines are deeply cleaned and fully protected for long-term durability. If you want to keep your surfaces looking brand new, getting professional grout sealing done right is a simple, high-value investment for your home. While our roots are here in California, we uphold national quality standards that rival top grout sealing in Oklahoma and across the country.
